name: Truthful record provenance and authenticated search
before: TellerRecordCard hard-coded Session record and Production persisted: No for every item, including records returned by authenticated Postgres serialization.
Records workspace used an unconfigured repository default even while App had authenticated API transport.
Search filtered only the first 100 hydrated records but could be mistaken for repository-wide search.
source_changes: Record cards label durable only when both server-produced persistence flags and a positive revision exist.
Repository connection is Verified only after an authenticated hydration request succeeds; Checking, Unavailable and Not connected remain distinct.
Explicit user-triggered server search uses Teller API text/category/status under bearer/RLS business authority, capped at 100 per search and clearly labelled.
Stale search responses are ignored after filter changes/closure; late responses from changed Tower actor/business are rejected in App.
Session-only records never receive blanket durable wording, and the existing local search remains available when remote search is unavailable.
